data.title: Cross-engine differential harness with claim quarantine, defect artifacts and ddmin minimization (test-only)

data.body:
[HIGH] Engine failures bypass the mandatory defect lifecycle. `compare_projection` converts every `Projection::Inconclusive`, including `EngineError`, only into `Undecided` at lines 308-320. The invariant path does the same at lines 457-473. Adapters map engine failures to `EngineError` at `crates/continuum-corpus/tests/support/engines.rs:48-53`, `:72-89`, and `:211-227`. The driver calls `evaluate` directly at `run.rs:264-267`, then creates a finding only when `disagreements.first()` exists at `run.rs:284-292`. A returned `EngineError` therefore creates no finding, `defect_*` handle, or quarantine. A panic prevents any `RunReport`. This conflicts with `defect.rs:1-6` and RFC 0026 lines 565-568, which require an engine failure to enter the defect lifecycle while remaining typed inconclusive.

Failure modes: one engine returns `EngineError`, both engines fail, or an adapter panics. All paths omit the required defect artifact. Edge cases: projection-only failure, one invariant failure, all-field failure, and panic before the answer is cached. Rollback: revert this harness, or separate engine-failure handling from semantic comparison and emit a defect before the no-disagreement path. Monitoring: fail any evidence-bearing lane with `EngineError`, and retain per-lane failure counts plus defect handles. Validation: add deterministic engines that return `EngineError` and panic. Require a typed inconclusive result, a `defect_*` report, and the intended claim halt. The pinned summary can detect current count drift, but it cannot create the required artifact and does not fix the public harness path.

[MEDIUM] An empty invariant map silently opts out of coverage. `check_side` validates predicate coverage only when the answer map is nonempty at lines 411-428. The comparison then iterates only subject entries at lines 453-476. No engine or lane capability declares whether invariant verdicts are required. A kernel or future optimized adapter can therefore drop every verdict, agree only on its projection, and create no disagreement or quarantine. `KernelEngine` currently promises every predicate at `crates/continuum-corpus/tests/support/engines.rs:255-279`, while the semantic oracle intentionally judges none at `:292-295` and `:385-388`; that distinction exists only in prose.

Failure modes: total verdict omission becomes a clean comparison. Partial omission is caught, which hides this boundary case. Edge cases: models with no predicates, projection-only lanes, kernel lanes, and future explicit or DPOR adapters. Rollback: require an explicit per-engine or per-lane field contract, then enforce exact predicate coverage for invariant-bearing lanes. Monitoring: record required, supplied, skipped, and compared invariant counts per lane. Reject unexplained zero coverage. Validation: clear all verdicts from a kernel-like answer and require `InvariantCoverage`; keep an explicitly projection-only semantic lane accepted. The current pinned `agreed` counts are useful counterevidence for this one corpus, but the public comparison remains fail-open.

data.body:
[HIGH] This finding remains open. `engine_failures` emits only when exactly one side has `EngineError`; the `(Some(_), Some(_))` branch does nothing at crates/continuum-corpus/src/differential/compare.rs:541-553. `compare_projection` then records both errors only as undecided at compare.rs:368-380. Invariant errors follow the same suppression at compare.rs:529-570 and :609-626. The test at crates/continuum-corpus/tests/cross_engine_differential.rs:830-851 locks this behavior. Two independent failures with unrelated details therefore produce no finding, `defect_*` report, or quarantine. A shared `EngineError` reason does not establish a shared model defect, especially because details are ignored. RFC 0026:565-567 requires the defect artifact while the result stays typed inconclusive.

Failure modes: both engines fail for different reasons, both hit a shared dependency failure, or one adapter copies the other error class. Edge cases: projection-only lanes, one invariant field, zero-predicate models, and identical versus distinct details. Rollback: retain the prior block, or report a joint engine failure whenever either side returns `EngineError`; use an explicit shared-model failure type if that distinction is required. Monitoring: count every `EngineError` field and require a corresponding defect handle; alert on any `EngineError/EngineError` undecided field without one. Validation: add same-detail and distinct-detail dual-error engines, then require typed inconclusiveness plus a `defect_*` report and claim quarantine.

[MEDIUM resolved] The repair derives required invariant names from the model at crates/continuum-corpus/src/differential/compare.rs:481-496. Persisted lanes declare required fields at crates/continuum-corpus/src/differential/claims.rs:55-95. Harness assembly enforces each engine contract at crates/continuum-corpus/src/differential/run.rs:344-375. Projection coverage is also checked at compare.rs:497-499. The empty-map regression test at crates/continuum-corpus/tests/cross_engine_differential.rs:941-1010 covers the former bypass. I found no remaining silent invariant-coverage opt-out in the persisted lanes.

data.body: [HIGH] This finding remains open at the assembly boundary. `Harness::new` executes `identity()` and `fields()` inside one guard, then converts either panic directly into `HarnessError::EnginePanicked` at crates/continuum-corpus/src/differential/run.rs:378-387. The public test at crates/continuum-corpus/tests/cross_engine_differential.rs:1094-1120 requires that plain error. No `RunReport` exists, so run.rs:515-520 cannot carry a finding, `defect_*` report, or claim quarantine. The dual-`EngineError` and `evaluate()` panic repairs are sound, but they do not cover this remaining engine-crash path. RFC 0026:565-567 requires every engine crash to publish the defect artifact while reporting typed inconclusiveness.\n\nFailure modes: `identity()` panics before a slot is known, or `fields()` panics after a usable identity was returned but the tuple guard discards it. Edge cases: projection-only engines, engines used by several lanes, and identical panic text from separate adapters. Rollback: retain this block or revert the harness until immutable slot/build/field data is supplied outside the panic-prone adapter calls and every setup crash can enter a harness-level defect lifecycle. Monitoring: reject any assembly error without a retained defect handle, engine position or identity, and affected-claim halt. Validation: use deterministic adapters that panic separately in `identity()` and `fields()`. Require a typed engine-failure result, a `defect_*` report, and claim quarantine instead of only `HarnessError`.

data.reason: HIGH: Engine identity or field-contract panics still return only HarnessError and bypass the required defect report and claim quarantine.

data.body: [HIGH resolved] The target fixes the assembly path. Harness::new accepts configuration-owned slot pairs and validates configuration before engine calls at crates/continuum-corpus/src/differential/run.rs:417-450. identity and fields execute under separate guards at run.rs:483-509. Any panic becomes a ContractFinding with the configured slot and every served claim at run.rs:456-480. Harness::run retains the finding and quarantines the full slot at run.rs:633-637. The regression at crates/continuum-corpus/tests/cross_engine_differential.rs:1394-1462 covers identity and fields panics. I found the prior assembly bypass closed.

data.reason: Assembly panic paths now emit contract defects and slot-wide quarantine at b28a303b81baf19e4432cb2ce7ea644da8168c97.

data.body:
[HIGH] A transient engine fault first observed during minimization can lose the required slot-wide quarantine. handle retains the first off-key fault and candidate at crates/continuum-corpus/src/differential/run.rs:821-824. run then evaluates that candidate again at run.rs:715-729 and supplies the fresh again comparison to both handle and enter at run.rs:730-741. Report claims at run.rs:861-869 and quarantine expansion at run.rs:599-600 derive faulting slots only from that fresh comparison, not from the retained fault. If the fault does not recur, the report still names the retained EngineFailure or EnginePanicked, but only the current lane claims are halted. The code explicitly anticipates non-repeatable engines through Minimality::NotReproduced at crates/continuum-corpus/src/differential/minimize.rs:32-36 and run.rs:849-856. A transient fault in the shared reference slot can therefore leave C005, C018, or C023 positive after the harness observed that slot fail.

Failure modes: a stateful adapter returns EngineError once during ddmin, a panic occurs only on the first candidate evaluation, or a fault changes field key before recheck. Edge cases: the faulting slot is subject or oracle, the reference slot serves several lanes, both sides fault, a zero-predicate model, and the recheck succeeds or fails under a different key. Rollback: retain this block, or stop reporting minimization-only faults until the retained record carries immutable faulting slot attribution; then derive report claims and quarantine from that retained attribution. Monitoring: reject any fault report whose claims and ledger entries do not equal every claim of every lane served by each named faulting slot. Validation: use a deterministic stateful engine that faults exactly once during candidate evaluation and then succeeds. Require a NotReproduced defect report plus slot-wide quarantine for subject and oracle cases. The current a_fault_met_while_minimizing_is_reported test at crates/continuum-corpus/tests/cross_engine_differential.rs:1600-1635 uses a repeatable panic and does not cover this loss.

data.reason: BLOCK: HIGH th-2jrmwr shows that a transient engine fault first observed during minimization can be reported without quarantining every lane of the faulting slot. The fresh recheck, not the retained fault, drives claims and ledger expansion. Reviewed the full persisted range a436f82d9d604545f9be0fe9c48773dfe0c02ae4..b28a303b81baf19e4432cb2ce7ea644da8168c97. The prior assembly-boundary HIGH is resolved. The separate risk:critical human-approval gate remains required.

data.body: [HIGH resolved] The target retains the observed minimization-time fault as `first` at crates/continuum-corpus/src/differential/run.rs:757-767. `handle` now includes `first` when it derives faulted slots at run.rs:895-898. `enter` expands every retained slot at run.rs:607-609, even when the fresh comparison is clean. The regression at crates/continuum-corpus/tests/cross_engine_differential.rs:1715-1806 covers a one-shot oracle panic and requires `NotReproduced` plus every reference-slot claim. This closes the prior lost-quarantine path. A separate multi-fault artifact-attribution issue is tracked in a new thread.

data.reason: The target retains the first observed transient fault and expands quarantine from that retained attribution.

data.body:
[HIGH] A second transient fault in one comparison is quarantined under an artifact that never records that fault. `run` selects only one fault as `first` at crates/continuum-corpus/src/differential/run.rs:696-700. `handle` derives `faulted_slots` from `first` plus every original disagreement at run.rs:895-898. It then stores only `first.to_string()` in the report at run.rs:899-907. `enter` expands every slot in that larger set under the one handle at run.rs:607-609. The encoded artifact has only `original.disagreement` and `minimized.disagreement` at crates/continuum-corpus/src/differential/defect.rs:181-199. If both adapters fault once on the original fixture and then recover, minimization does not add the second fault to `met`. The report therefore quarantines both slots, but its artifact identifies only the selected side. This violates RFC 0026:565-566 and prevents an independent reader from verifying why the second slot was halted.

Failure modes: both sides return one-shot `EngineError`, both panic once, or one panics while the other returns `EngineError`. Edge cases: distinct fault keys, zero minimization budget, an empty fixture, only one side recovering, and shared slots serving several lanes. Rollback: retain this block, or create an immutable finding for every original fault key before minimization. An alternative is to encode the complete fault list and slot attribution in the artifact. Monitoring: require every faulted slot and every slot-wide ledger expansion to map to encoded fault evidence for that exact side and key. Validation: use two stateful adapters that each fault exactly once on the same original fixture, then become clean. Require two defect artifacts, or one artifact that encodes both faults, plus exact slot-wide quarantine. Repeat with panic plus `EngineError` and a zero-test minimization budget.

data.reason: HIGH: one report can quarantine a second transiently faulting slot without encoding that second fault; see th-3qaesq.

data.body: [HIGH resolved] The target closes the multi-fault attribution gap. DefectReport encodes every observed fault as a sorted slot/evidence pair at crates/continuum-corpus/src/differential/defect.rs:132-143 and :193-226. Harness::handle collects the retained fault plus every fault in the source comparison at crates/continuum-corpus/src/differential/run.rs:901-925. Harness::enter derives slot-wide quarantine only from those encoded pairs at run.rs:595-618. Failure modes: dual one-shot EngineError, dual panic, and mixed panic/EngineError now retain both slots and evidence. Edge cases: distinct keys, zero minimization budget, NotReproduced fallback, and shared multi-lane slots remain encoded before quarantine expansion. Rollback: revert defect format /2 and this quarantine change together if an artifact consumer cannot read the new format. Monitoring: require every ledger entry and faulted slot to map to the report encoding, as inspected at crates/continuum-corpus/tests/cross_engine_differential.rs:1849-1995. Validation: the dual-transient regression at tests/cross_engine_differential.rs:1998-2113 exercises separate faults and encoded slot attribution. Static review found the prior blocker closed.

data.reason: Defect format /2 now hashes complete per-slot fault evidence, and quarantine expansion reads only that encoded evidence.

The format /2 report encodes every fault used for slot-wide quarantine, and the prior HIGH thread th-3qaesq is resolved. No security blocker remains in this bounded static review. data.body:
[HIGH] Undefined-read validation skips reachability when an engine lacks an exact projection. `replay_side` passes `None` for every non-`Exact` projection at compare.rs:627-630. `check_undefined` then rejects an unreached state only when a set exists at replay.rs:184-187. The kernel lane can pair undefined reads with `Cardinality` or `Inconclusive` at tests/support/engines.rs:324-375. A faulty engine can cite any valid but unreachable state where the chain is false. The harness increments `undefined_checked` at compare.rs:631-648 and can accept the verdict as agreement.

Failure modes: cardinality-only or inconclusive engines cite unreachable undefined states, which become checked evidence. Edge cases: action and invariant reads, same or different subjects, matching counts, budget stops, and producer-refusal paths. Rollback: retain this block, or require independent reachability evidence before accepting any undefined read. Treat missing reachability proof as typed inconclusive, not checked. Monitoring: reject every `undefined_checked` increment that lacks an exact reached-set membership check or equivalent certificate evidence. Validation: add a model with an unreachable state where a definedness chain is false. Make cardinality and inconclusive mutants cite that state. Require `InvalidUndefined(Unreached)` or a typed undecided result, with no checked agreement.

[HIGH] The model-level `undefined_action` field accepts an invariant read, despite its action-only contract. `Normalized::undefined_action` requires an undefined action read at normal.rs:162-164. `replay_side` calls `check_undefined` with no invariant at compare.rs:631-639. The generic branch at replay.rs:196-215 validates either kind from `read.kind`. `compare_undefined_action` then counts any two present values as agreement at compare.rs:470-480, without comparing their kinds. A faulty engine can replace a real action read with a valid invariant read and still agree.

Failure modes: an engine substitutes an invariant undefined read in the action slot, or two engines report different categories. Edge cases: both categories fail at one state or different states, the same subject name exists in both chains, and per-invariant verdicts remain correct. Rollback: retain this block, or reject every model-level read whose kind is not `Action` before generic model validation. Monitoring: require the action slot kind to be `Action` before incrementing `undefined_checked` or `agreed`. Validation: build a model with both action and invariant undefined reads. Mutate only `undefined_action` to the valid invariant read. Require `InvalidUndefined` or `UndefinedAction` disagreement and claim quarantine.

data.reason: Two HIGH fail-open paths let invalid undefined-read evidence become checked agreement: non-exact projections skip reachability proof, and the action-only model field accepts invariant reads. See threads th-28049x and th-2r68ob. The separate risk:critical human-approval gate remains required.

[HIGH resolved] The model-level field now accepts only action reads. check_undefined rejects any other kind as NotAnActionRead at crates/continuum-corpus/src/differential/replay.rs:233-236. compare_undefined_action records agreement only when both reads are action-kind and proven at crates/continuum-corpus/src/differential/compare.rs:482-498. An invalid invariant read no longer suppresses deadlock comparison at compare.rs:832-840. The regression at crates/continuum-corpus/tests/cross_engine_differential.rs:2571-2621 covers two smuggled invariant reads and requires two InvalidUndefined findings.\n\nFailure modes: one engine substitutes an invariant read, both engines substitute one, or the categories differ. Edge cases: both categories fail at one state, the subject names overlap, one side omits the field, and projections are exact or incomplete. Rollback: retain this block, or disable model-level undefined comparison until the action-only contract is enforced. Monitoring: require Action before agreement and before deadlock suppression. Count NotAnActionRead as a defect. Validation: the added regression proves that two identical invalid categories do not agree and do not suppress deadlock comparison.
